summary: Trio-Tech International filed an 8-K disclosing a registered direct offering of 1,052,632 shares of common stock at $9.50 per share for ~$10M gross proceeds, closed April 27, 2026. The shelf takedown under Registration No. 333-291219 included a 4.5% placement agent fee to D. Boral Capital LLC. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf, not a special situation event.
